BALATROJOKERS-BARON.description: [gold]Rare[/gold] cards gain [gold]Retain[/gold]. Enemies deal [blue]5%[/blue] less damage for every [gold]Rare[/gold] card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
BALATROJOKERS-BARON.title: Baron
BALATROJOKERS-BLUEPRINT.description: Upon pickup, obtain {Relic.StringValue:cond:[gold]{Relic}[/gold]|a copy of your last obtained [gold]Relic[/gold]}.
BALATROJOKERS-BLUEPRINT.title: Blueprint
BALATROJOKERS-CAMPFIRE.description: You can now [gold]Upgrade[/gold] {Cards:plural:a card|[blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards} at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold]
BALATROJOKERS-CAMPFIRE.title: Campfire
BALATROJOKERS-CREDIT_CARD.title: Credit Card
BALATROJOKERS-GOLDEN_TICKET.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Rare[/gold] card, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
BALATROJOKERS-GOLDEN_TICKET.title: Golden Ticket
BALATROJOKERS-MYSTIC_SUMMIT.description: While there are no cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
BALATROJOKERS-MYSTIC_SUMMIT.title: Mystic Summit
BALATROJOKERS-DNA.description: The first {CombatThreshold:plural:time|[blue]{CombatThreshold}[/blue] times} each act you end your turn having played only [blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue] card, add a permanent copy of it into your [gold]Deck[/gold] and put it into your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the start of your next turn.
BALATROJOKERS-DNA.title: DNA
BALATROJOKERS-BRAINSTORM.description: Upon pickup, obtain {StarterRelic.StringValue:cond:[gold]{StarterRelic}[/gold]|a copy of your starter [gold]Relic[/gold]}.
BALATROJOKERS-BRAINSTORM.title: Brainstorm
BALATROJOKERS-MADNESS.description: The first attack each turn deals [blue]{MadnessPower}%[/blue] additional damage. Whenever you kill an [gold]Elite[/gold], increase the damage by an additional [blue]{AdditionalPercentage}%[/blue] and destroy a random [gold]Relic[/gold]. Cannot destroy your starter [gold]Relic[/gold].
BALATROJOKERS-MADNESS.title: Madness
BALATROJOKERS-BURNT_JOKER.description: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it for the remainder of combat.
BALATROJOKERS-BURNT_JOKER.title: Burnt Joker
BALATROJOKERS-DRIVERS_LICENSE.descriptio: If you have at least [blue]{CardMinimum}[/blue] [gold]Enchanted[/gold] {CardMinimum:plural:card|cards} in your deck, start each combat with [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
BALATROJOKERS-DRIVERS_LICENSE.title: Driver's License
BALATROJOKERS-HALF_JOKER.description: Whenever you play [blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue] or fewer cards during your turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies at the end of your turn.
BALATROJOKERS-HALF_JOKER.title: Half Joker
BALATROJOKERS-THE_DUO.description: Whenever you have exactly [blue]{Cards}[/blue] of the same card in your [gold]Hand[/gold], deal double damage.
BALATROJOKERS-THE_DUO.title: The Duo
BALATROJOKERS-THE_TRIO.description: Whenever you have exactly [blue]{Cards}[/blue] of the same card in your [gold]Hand[/gold], deal triple damage.
BALATROJOKERS-THE_TRIO.title: The Trio
BALATROJOKERS-THE_FAMILY.description: Whenever you have exactly [blue]{Cards}[/blue] of the same card in your [gold]Hand[/gold], deal quadruple damage.
BALATROJOKERS-THE_FAMILY.title: The Family
BALATROJOKERS-THE_ORDER.description: Whenever you play an [gold]Attack[/gold], [gold]Skill[/gold], and [gold]Power[/gold] in that order in a single turn, deal triple damage at the start of your next turn.
BALATROJOKERS-THE_ORDER.title: The Order
BALATROJOKERS-THE_TRIBE.description: Whenever you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} of the same type or rarity in a row in a single turn, deal double damage at the start of your next turn.
BALATROJOKERS-THE_TRIBE.title: The Tribe
BALATROJOKERS-SPLASH.description: At the end of your turn, deal damage equal to the amount of cards played this turn to a random enemy.
BALATROJOKERS-SPLASH.title: Splash
BALATROJOKERS-ASTRONOMER.description: Whenever you enter a shop room, a random card, relic, and potion from the [gold]Merchant[/gold] becomes free.
BALATROJOKERS-ASTRONOMER.title: Astronomer
BALATROJOKERS-MARBLE_JOKER.description: At the start of Elite combats, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Giant Rock|Giant Rocks}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. {Cards:plural:It's|They're} free to play this turn.
BALATROJOKERS-MARBLE_JOKER.title: Marble Joker
